description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_SetAutoloadFilters, which provides methods related to setting autoload filters in the Smarty templating engine. It includes functionality to assign filters based on type and checks for valid filter types, handling exceptions for invalid types.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_SetAutoloadFilters
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to set autoload filters in the Smarty templating engine and validate filter types.

methods.name: setAutoloadFilters
methods.description: Sets autoload filters for Smarty templates, either by type or by default if no type is specified.

methods.name: _checkFilterType
methods.description: Validates if a filter type is allowed; throws an exception if the type is invalid.
